growth_signal.value: Its security software is embedded in over 2 billion chips globally, protecting more than 1 billion devices at runtime and blocking over 100,000 attacks in a fraction of a second.

raised.value: $270M round at a $1.7B valuation, after an earlier €100M round

entry.idea: Exein builds security software that runs directly inside the firmware of connected devices and machines, detecting and stopping cyberattacks on the device itself in real time.
entry.lesson: Building security into the hardware layer itself, rather than bolting it on later, becomes far more valuable once regulators start requiring it by law.
entry.name: Exein

growth.reason: It protects over 1 billion devices, has blocked over 100,000 attacks, and jumped from a €100M round to a $270M round at unicorn valuation.

market.reason: Every industry with connected devices or machinery, from cars to factories to consumer electronics, needs this kind of security, a very large and essential market.

tech.reason: Building real-time security that runs inside firmware across billions of chips is deep, hard-to-copy engineering built over years with major chipmaker partnerships.

sources.title: New Italian unicorn Exein rides the physical AI wave | TechCrunch
Exein becomes unicorn: Italian Physical AI security start-up valued at $1.7bn | Euronews
Italian-based cybersecurity startup Exein secures €100M led by Blue Cloud Ventures | Vestbee

entry.twist: It protects hardware at the chip and operating-system level rather than adding security on top afterward, and is now expanding that same approach to secure physical AI systems like robots and autonomous machinery.
entry.who_pays: Device makers and industrial companies pay to embed Exein's security software into their products so they meet regulations and protect their devices in the field.
entry.why_now: As more physical devices and AI-powered machines connect to networks, new laws like the EU's Cyber Resilience Act require built-in security, and attackers increasingly target the hardware itself, not just software.
